source.stem:
The diameter of a copper wire is thought to be approximately 0.3 mm.
Which instrument should be used to obtain a more accurate measurement of the diameter of the wire?

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Pressure acts only downward because water sits on the bottom.

intelligence.enrichment: When land heats the warm moist air above it, the lighter air rises and creates a low-pressure area; cooler air from surrounding high-pressure areas flows in, warms, rises, cools, and its water vapour condenses into clouds and rain. Surface heating starts rising moist air; rising creates low pressure; inflow supplies more air; repeated rising, cooling, and condensation build storm clouds and rainfall. The learner explains thunderstorm formation as a chain from heated land to rising moist air, low pressure, inflow, cooling, condensation, clouds, and precipitation. A thunderstorm happens simply because rain clouds get heavy and fall, without pressure-driven air circulation.
